items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Well, I played alongside of Duke Ellington, see? Yeah. At the Roseland Ballroom.

ctx.x: Wellman Bro, he said he played with Duke Ellington. He said you were his favorite bass player. Yeah, I told him that last month. He said you were the greatest bass player I ever heard. Well, maybe... You'd know him if you saw him, I'm sure. I think so. You'd know him if you saw him.

Well, I played alongside of Duke Ellington, see? Yeah. At the Roseland Ballroom. They have two bandstands there, see? And they used to have that for a novel. They had one colored orchestra and one white orchestra. And when the Victor band opened up, why... We had a good band. And this Duke Ellington band was good. And also... Do you have one? No, the... Cornette player, Armstrong. Oh. I played alongside of Armstrong, I was saying, see? And Armstrong would come up there. We used to have more fun with Louis than…
What about McKinney's? That's another band.
